items.html: Do not be surprised if you will find several places in the Zohar where Etz ha Daat is good, Matatron, and bad, Sam’el. This is because Etz ha Daat is not only in Assiya where there are Klipot mixed with Kedusha. However, after Yetzira came down and clothed in Assiya, Yetzira is called “Etz ha Daat of good and bad”, the name of Assiya. Thus we have thoroughly explained what was Etz ha Daat.
